observations: Context preserves the original foreground shapes; it avoids the large background leakage of native 512 inference.
Printed-paper, bicycle, boar, sloth and painted checker retain material confusion or missing thin detail; finer RGB does not solve their classification.
Rabbit and outdoor red/white checker lose crop proposals; blue/yellow checker remains but has uneven cell boundaries and false gaps.
Small changes in labels and edge support can flip geometric crop gates, despite almost unchanged mean pixel scores. Gates were not relaxed.

decision: Do not deploy this inference change. Test adaptation and foreground preservation separately.
